source: SRC-APH-APPEAL-2024-27; AICTE Approval Process Handbook 2024-27, Chapter II §§2.23.3, 2.24(a-f), PDF pp. 44-45 (printed pp. 29-30), verified 2026-10-27; implements PRD FR-27.
note: Verified Chapter II appeal policy. The seven-day filing period is measured as seven elapsed 24-hour periods from the accepted Executive Committee decision transition, which records the portal decision with its linked Speaking Order in one audited operation. The file upload may precede that operation and does not itself start the deadline. Appeal filing is limited to one per application. This policy is not extended to other APH chapters or decision-makers.
scope_note: Chapter II existing-institution flow only. The Chapter I new_technical route is excluded until its Chapter I appeal procedure is separately verified and implemented.

trigger.note: The accepted Executive Committee decision transition records the portal decision and linked Speaking Order atomically; its created_at is the verified clock trigger. Speaking Order file upload may be earlier and is not the publication time. Legacy decisions without a linked order cannot be appealed through this flow.

receiving_authority.label: Standing Appellate Committee (SAC)
receiving_authority.note: AICTE notifies the hearing schedule on its web portal; the prototype records the schedule through an explicitly assigned SAC application role.

reminder_thresholds.note: PRD §11 line 288 — first reminder, day 3 of the 7-day window.
PRD §11 line 288 — second reminder, day 6 of the 7-day window (the day before it closes).
